marketplace.description: Where these pages read the blueprint/operator catalog, which lives in the release namespace. MUST match the portal chart's marketplace.source.
marketplace.title: marketplace

namespace.description: The namespace this chart CREATES and installs its page objects into. It is the RBAC boundary the chart exists for — a group with no RoleBinding here cannot `list` the page roots, so the portal sidebar never shows them and the page body 403s on a deep link. The release itself stays in the portal's namespace (the shell), and only these objects live here.
namespace.title: namespace

readerGroups.description: Groups granted read of these pages in `namespace`. A group listed here sees /blueprints in the sidebar and can open it; a group absent cannot list the page roots, so the entry never renders. No schema default: the installer applies schema defaults, so one here would silently re-assert itself over a group set through componentValues. The chart default lives in values.yaml instead.
readerGroups.title: readerGroups
